routing_contract: primitive is a deterministic function of measured M_e aperture and route heading change; never segment index

anchor_policy.description: candidate zero may use a validated conditional-mean/SEED anchor

online_conditioning.contract: probe rollout -> measured executed 69-D state and 12-frame history -> per-segment Flow reconditioning

probe_execution.phase_contract: nearest-pose handoff plus continuous 50 Hz phase; no per-segment phase reset
probe_execution.root_progress_contract: route progress/yaw command is computed from measured pelvis state; frozen SONIC does not consume root position directly, so these commands are logged for the closed-loop scheduler and future controller fine-tuning

optimization_embedded_projection.contract: projected-gradient feasibility layer between Flow decode and SONIC gate
optimization_embedded_projection.root_position_note: root position is projected for target consistency; current SONIC action head consumes joint pose/velocity and base orientation, so MuJoCo execution remains authoritative

receding_horizon.contract: actual state/history -> Flow decode -> projection -> continuous rollout gate

environment_manifold.contract: world-aligned M_e(t) interpolated from each route segment condition

robot_self_manifold.contract: M_e(t) -> primitive selection -> measured body envelope -> primitive-conditioned M_r(t)

robot_self_manifold_safety.contract: measured safe M_r broad phase -> exact G1 surface/obstacle narrow phase
robot_self_manifold_safety.task_manifold_aperture_contract: crouch checks vertical M_r/M_e; side gait checks route-lateral M_r/M_e

projection.contract: projected-gradient joint limits + temporal smoothness + route-center root consistency
